_doc: Canonical 5-tab IA gating (#226). revealTier = the tier at which a tab first appears in the nav; unlockTier = the tier at which it goes live (below it the tab shows a locked teaser). Home + Operations are always present and unlocked. This protects the validated T1 onboarding: at T1 only Home + Operations appear — no empty tabs on day one. v1 covers tiers 1-3; Growth's unlockTier 4 is the seam, intentionally never live in v1.
